name: The Recorded 267-Class Excludes Known Twelve-Coordinate Inverse Adversaries
statement: In the marked-reduction theorem, let the overlap be the recorded twelve-coordinate obstruction $O=Y_{267}$. No proper pc-minor of the expansion is isomorphic to $Y_{267}$ or to any of the 1364-vertex maximum-pair rectangular obstructions.
proof: Every coordinate reduction of $Y_{267}$ has $267-208=59$ concepts, while its nonempty elementary restrictions have orders from 77 through 190 and its contractions have order 208. Thus the necessary one-operation cardinality match fails for a proper minor isomorphic to $Y_{267}$. In a rectangular obstruction $H=(P_1\times O_2)\cup(O_1\times P_2)$, a reduction in either six-coordinate block has order $16\cdot22+6\cdot(42-22)=472$. Since both candidate adversaries use twelve coordinates and 472 exceeds every elementary-minor order of $Y_{267}$, the same test excludes the rectangular family.
comments: The exclusion is limited to twelve-coordinate proper minors. A forbidden minor on fewer coordinates is not ruled out by the one-operation argument, so this does not prove the unrestricted inverse construction sound.
